title: Hivestorm alien flight state diagram
description: How one alien flies. The Game drives it in moveAliens(), launchDives(), wrap() and kill(). At the start of every turn and wave, loadHive() rebuilds every alien in home, alive or not as the player's survivors say.

states.description: In its slot in the swaying hive.
Turning out of the hive on a circular arc.
Flying down at the player, steering and firing; an escort flies in formation with its queen.
Coming down from the top of the screen to its slot.
alive = false: shot, or it rammed the ship.

transitions.guard: the dive cooldown is over and fewer than maxDivers(wave) are out, or it is a swarm
transitions.action: startDive(): side, arc, shots and fire delay; emit dive.

transitions.guard: a guard within one column of the queen, at most two
transitions.action: leader = the queen; keep its offset.

transitions.trigger: moveAliens(): its queen is gone or home

transitions.guard: not a swarm, or the phase isn't play
transitions.action: Re-enter at the top above its slot.
